name: The Pearl
tagline: Central, fast Wi-Fi, built for work trips
shortDescription: A 2BHK apartment near Rajpur Road, 5 minutes by car — thoughtfully designed interiors with a full kitchen, AC, high-speed WiFi, and free parking.
description: The Pearl is a 2BHK apartment located just off Rajpur Road, a five-minute drive away, with easy access to the Mussoorie Road route and Dehradun's local attractions. The entire apartment is yours for the stay — a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, WiFi, and dedicated parking, all set within interiors that have been thoughtfully designed for comfort rather than just looks.
Whether you're here to explore the city or use it as a base before heading up to Mussoorie, The Pearl offers a private, well-equipped space to settle in and relax.

location.address: Aspen Residence, near Rajpur Road, Dehradun
location.directionsNote: Gated parking on site. 10 minutes from Dehradun Railway Station, 35 minutes from Jolly Grant Airport.

reviews.text: Stayed two weeks for work. The desk setup and fibre Wi-Fi made it actually usable as a base, not just a place to sleep.
Kitchenette had everything I needed to not eat out every meal. Building felt secure, good elevator, easy parking.
Clean and central. Only note: ask for extra towels at check-in if you need them, wasn't automatic.

name: The Cove
tagline: More space, quieter street, built for families
shortDescription: A studio apartment inside a mall in Dehradun, with a private balcony overlooking the Mussoorie hills — an intimate space designed for two.
description: The Cove is a studio apartment set inside a mall in Dehradun, offering the rare convenience of shopping, cafes, and everyday essentials just steps from your door. Step out onto the private balcony and take in an open view of the Mussoorie hills — a quiet, scenic backdrop right in the middle of the city.

Designed as an intimate retreat for two, The Cove pairs thoughtfully finished interiors with the ease of having everything you need close by. Whether you're winding down after a day of exploring or simply enjoying the view with your morning coffee, The Cove offers a compact, comfortable stay with a setting unlike anywhere else in Dehradun.
Each apartment has two bathrooms in the larger layouts, a full kitchen rather than a kitchenette, and a washing machine — genuinely set up to live in, not just stay in.

location.address: Cedar Residence, off Rajpur Road, Dehradun
location.directionsNote: Five minutes' drive from Aspen Residence. On-site parking for two cars per apartment.

reviews.text: Booked the 3BHK for a week with grandparents and kids. Having a real kitchen and the garden downstairs made it feel like a proper holiday, not a hotel stay.
Quiet street, genuinely spacious, washing machine was a lifesaver on a 10-day trip.
